create_model_card: create an LCM model card from a checkpoint path and model config for fairseq2 asset registration
load_model_from_card: load an LCM model from a model card name, YAML file path, or training directory
create_model_card_from_training_folder: create a model card by extracting config and checkpoint from a training folder directory
load_model_with_overrides: load an LCM model from a directory supporting both new model card and old config formats
save_model_card: save an LCM model card as a YAML file to the specified output path
